set.body: Objective: validate Reframe4s against exact Gale candidate f869613cec0a89e57b6c995b0a02cf471ac7127c for the Gale v0.1.0-M1 ecosystem checkpoint. Contract: use the immutable Gale SHA or candidate coordinate, migrate removed API callers rather than restoring aliases, run every relevant JVM and Scala.js gate, and inspect generated dependency metadata for publishable artifacts. Non-goals: no unrelated feature work, no maturity claim, no consumer release. Acceptance: record the consumer SHA, Gale SHA, exact commands and counts, relevant platform results, source migrations, and generated POM dependency closure; move the permanent pin only after the gates pass.
set.title: Validate Reframe4s against Gale 0.1 M1 candidate
